name: No sumps (conveyance only)

name: Full cleaning
description: All 7 catch basins vacuumed on schedule: every sump keeps its full 2 ft of storage.

name: No cleaning + street sweeping
description: Sumps neglected as in S3, but the streets are swept every 14 days. Can sweeping stand in for basin cleaning?
